// diagnostic

E1113

`{name}` cannot {action}; it was frozen at {freeze_site}

What

`{name}` cannot {action}; it was frozen at {freeze_site}

Why

`freeze(...)` creates a deeply immutable owned snapshot so a task can read it without a race. A write through any field or index would change that snapshot.

Fix

Create a new value, freeze a new snapshot, or use `Shared`/`Cell` when shared mutation is intentional

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1113: tests/ui/frozen_write.stderr.

Error [E1113]: `frozen` cannot be assigned; it was frozen at `freeze(...)` at byte 86
  --> tests/ui/frozen_write.jet:8:12
    |
  8 |     frozen.value = 2
    |            ^^^^^
 Why: `freeze(...)` creates a deeply immutable owned snapshot so a task can read it without a race. A write through any field or index would change that snapshot.
 Fix: create a new value, freeze a new snapshot, or use `Shared`/`Cell` when shared mutation is intentional
